title: Signature: Secret blast-radius map
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): when a secret is found exposed, the blast-radius map shows everywhere it was used: which services, which repositories, which logs. Rotation is not complete until every usage in the map is covered. The map is built from code search and access logs. title: Signature: Detector evasion tests
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the detector is tested against obfuscated secrets: base64-encoded, split across lines, concatenated from parts. Evasion tests prove the detector catches real-world hiding attempts, not just textbook examples. New evasions become regression tests. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers testing against encoded and split secrets.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ["AKIA1234"], 2: ["QUtJQTEyMzQ=", "AKIA" + "1234"], 3: ["QUtJQTEyMzQ=", "AK" + "IA1234", "QUtJ\nQTEyMzQ="]}
import base64, re
def caught(s):
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", "", s)
    try: t = base64.b64decode(t).decode(errors="ignore") + " " + t
    except Exception: pass
    return "AKIA" in t
res = [(s, caught(s)) for s in CFG[LEVEL]]
for s, c in res: print(repr(s)[:30], "->", "caught" if c else "MISSED")
print("evasion coverage: %d/%d" % (sum(c for _, c in res), len(res)))
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Commit-time gate
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): secrets are blocked before they reach the repository: a pre-commit hook scans staged changes and rejects commits containing secrets. Blocking at commit time is cheaper than rotating after push, and the gate teaches developers with immediate feedback. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers pre-commit scanning of staged changes.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "fix typo", 2: "add config\npassword=hunter2", 3: "add config\npassword=${SECRET_REF}"}
diff = CFG[LEVEL]
bad = "password=hunter2" in diff or "AKIA" in diff
print("commit message: %r" % diff.split(chr(10))[0], "| gate:", "REJECTED: secret in diff" if bad else "passed")
